rules: One extraordinary cadre allocation funds reserve networks or provincial offices; Front participation and sovereignty remain compatible.
Food production and rations are a shared funding priority, not a claim that the other activity is illegal.

Research grants are finite, do not remove ahead-of-time penalties and do not award technologies.
